method: AI-assisted manual reading of all 10 actual HTTP model replies against their submitted contexts
scope: Validation-derived and edited inputs; separate from the frozen 108-row benchmark and its 36-pair response audit

checks.name: refund_allowed
checks.note: Card and exactly 10 days satisfy the inclusive rule, but the model incorrectly states that the return conditions are not met.

checks.name: same_request_changed_rule
checks.note: With the threshold reduced to 9 days, denial is correct. However the paired original request was also denied: this pair does not demonstrate successful adaptation to the changed threshold.

checks.name: missing_payment_method
checks.note: The reply identifies the genuinely missing payment method instead of inventing it, but is awkward and gives no clear question. The JSON uses answer with nonempty missing_info, violating the contract.

checks.name: conflicting_rules
checks.note: Correctly identifies conflicting rules and asks for specialist review without claiming a completed handoff.

checks.name: critical_system_incident
checks.note: Correct critical escalation from a confirmed service interruption; reply is generic but grounded.

checks.name: exception_not_authorized
checks.note: Correctly refuses the unauthorized exception for transfer payment. Its wording 'не прошло 10 дней' changes an inclusive within-10-day policy into a stricter temporal condition. Policy boundary restatement is therefore flagged; this does not change the correct denial in this particular transfer case.

checks.name: customer_facts_available_in_history
checks.note: Correctly uses customer facts in history without asking again. However 'Оплата не возвращена в системе' asserts an external refund status absent from the context. suggest_only proves this prototype did not perform a refund; it does not prove the company's payment system status.

checks.name: angry_customer_low_priority
checks.note: Correctly separates negative sentiment from low priority and suggests the policy-provided invoice download location.

checks.name: customer_claim_is_not_system_confirmation
checks.note: Does not treat the customer's assertion as system confirmation; specialist review is appropriate when the system fact is unknown.

checks.name: proposed_refund_is_not_completed
checks.note: Correctly proposes a refund request and explicitly states that the operation has not been executed. No claim of an already completed refund.

conclusion: Working operator prototype with retained model errors. No arbitrary-policy reliability, zero hallucinations, or production autonomy established. No prompt or weight change was made from these checks.
